summary: Phases 0 to 3 are done: the engine, the feel and the pods. Real tools are next.

items.title: Plan
items.text: Full rewrite plan, decisions locked: web first, custom API, four drones, glass goo.

items.title: 0 · Foundation
items.text: Clean project, folder layout, strict TypeScript, tests, design tokens.

items.title: 1 · Engine
items.text: Rounded rail, fixed-step loop, rail-space springs, glass renderer, eye state machine.

items.title: 2 · Feel & polish
items.text: Fling and snap points, feel presets, long-press menu, keyboard control, reduced motion.

items.title: 3 · Pods
items.text: Drones ooze into glass panels that open toward the screen centre and morph into each other.

items.title: 4 · Tools
items.text: Attach, Quick Notes, Clipboard Editor, Prompt Presets. Local storage, export and import.

items.title: 5 · AI
items.text: Custom API adapter with streaming, Ask panel, Run with AI, rewrite actions, thinking and speaking eye.

items.title: 6 · Settings 2.0
items.text: New settings panel with live preview, saved between sessions, AI profiles.

items.title: 8 · Native
items.text: Windows overlay, then Android floating bubble.

items.title: Beyond
items.text: More AI providers, an offline in-browser model, AI that can act on drones, custom drones, a browser extension.
